gold: Pott's puffy tumor with sinocutaneous fistula secondary to chronic sinusitis

selector.rationale: Actinomycosis best explains the chronic discharge of pus and the presence of an immovable scarlike node on the right upper eyelid, with supportive imaging findings of high signal on T2-weighted image and ring enhancement in the right frontal sinus.

rejected.label: Frontal sinus mucocele
rejected.why: While frontal sinus mucocele could explain some imaging findings, it does not fully account for the chronic pus discharge and the specific characteristics of the node on the eyelid.
